caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of clothing, which is a black jacket with wide, flared sleeves and an asymmetrical, layered hem. The jacket features intricate, colorful embroidery along the front edges, around the neckline, at the ends of the sleeves, and along the lower hem. The embroidery consists of floral and leaf patterns in shades of yellow, green, blue, red, and pink. The jacket is shown on a plain, pale background with no additional objects or features present. The perspective is from the front, and the garment is unbuttoned or open, revealing no interior lining or undergarments.
title: Jacket
